explication: Unitree Mujoco is a dual-language MuJoCo simulator for validating Unitree SDK2, ROS2, and Python controllers before deployment. The principal workflow is: select a robot and scene, load the MJCF model, step physics, exchange low-level commands and state through DDS, and observe the simulated robot. C++ and Python provide parallel runtimes; joystick input, elastic-band forces, terrain generation, and many robot descriptions are supporting capabilities. The graph reflects sampled entrypoints and bridges; some C++ orchestration is inferred from documented structure.
